actions.summary: Created two approved unpaid synthetic TEST orders and scoped reservations with one expired and one unexpired.
A guarded temporary TEST cron released only the expired reservation, then was removed. Two additional expiry calls each returned zero.
Invoked the TEST reconciliation endpoint with an empty queue; HTTP 200 and zero counts do not demonstrate processing an actual payment job.
Matched the existing TEST order in the merchant dashboard and observed EXPIRED; removed and reload-verified the temporary browser guard.
Released only the owned expired TEST reservation after provider and database preconditions matched; stock returned to 10.
Executed reviewed reconciliation handler with actual Toss TEST GET on owned canceled payment and isolated mocked RPC: claimed/reconciled 1, repeat 0, no provider mutation.
Exercised actual TEST DB claim and apply functions in a deliberately rolled-back subtransaction on the owned fixture; original state and counts were verified unchanged.

blocker.required_action: Determine whether a nonempty deployed Edge-to-actual-DB end-to-end test can be safely performed within the no-additional-payment requirement; the real provider and rollback database paths were verified separately.
